$comment: Template only — not a real config. Copy to <repo-root>/security-sensitive.json in the target project and replace every entry with that project's actual sensitive files. This file is the machine-read source of truth for the security-impact skill; a project's CONTRIBUTING.md may restate this in prose for humans, but nothing should ever parse that prose.

sensitive_files.reason: Parses untrusted input before validation. Size limits, schema enforcement, and error handling must be preserved.
invariants: Untrusted input always goes through the size/nesting-limit check before JSON.parse
Never parse the raw input a second time through a different path

sensitive_files.reason: Resolves filesystem paths from names that may be attacker- or user-influenced. Path traversal guards must be preserved.
invariants: All resolved paths are checked with startsWith(base + sep) before use
Names are validated against the project's name-pattern regex before any filesystem operation
